subject: New ship-to for SO-20817
body: We just moved into our new warehouse in Longmont and I already added it to our account.
Can you send SO-20817 there instead of the Boulder studio?
It needs to land by Thursday either way.

truth.handling: SO-20817 was picked at 6:40 this morning, and address changes stop at the pick, so the change to the Longmont warehouse waits for the order desk. The reply says a person will confirm the reroute.
